name: push press
description: An overhead press helped by a quick leg dip and drive. It lets you handle heavier loads for the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.
